pages.text: Printers have upgrade slots equal to their tier (T3 = 3 slots). Shift+Right Click a module onto the machine to install it:$(br)$(li)$(item)Speed$() — faster printing$(li)$(item)Efficiency$() — less FU per print$(li)$(item)RF Efficiency$() — less power$(li)$(item)Buffer$() — bigger RF tank

pages.title: Stacking
pages.text: Modules stack $(l)multiplicatively$() — two Speed Upgrades make prints 0.8 × 0.8 = 64% of the base time, never zero.$(br2)All module rates are exposed in the config for pack makers.
